closed_children.title: Gate: docs up to date (exchange branch + step)

description:
Replace v0.1's direct-to-main exchange commit with an exchange branch.

=== What to build ===
1. On each 'lernie prompt' invocation, spawn branch ex/<ts>-<id> off main (§2.3).
2. Allocate a worktree for the branch.
3. Write .agent/goal.md at spawn time (§2.8) — goal = the user message for v0.2. Pin goal at head of the model-call context (context assembly is still minimal; manifest.yaml-driven v0.6).
4. Within the branch, write the step's snapshot commit BEFORE issuing the model call (§2.10 — 'commit before model call' for replay/retry). Commit carries the request JSON or a pointer.
5. Issue the model call via the provider adapter (unchanged from v0.1).
6. Write the step's output (response, usage, stop_reason) onto the branch — either as a follow-up commit or by amending the snapshot commit's tree. Pick one and document.
7. Do NOT merge back yet — that's task (2). Leave the branch open with branches.json reflecting it.

=== Shape ===
- One exchange = one step = one step commit (v0.2 has no tools, so the linear-commits property is trivially satisfied).
- Step naming, commit message shape, and on-disk layout of the step output should be taxonomy-consistent (§2.1) and line up with what v0.3 will extend (tool calls added to the same commit / same dir).

=== Out of scope ===
- Compaction, merge (task 2).
- branches.json updates are stubbed here; task (3) does the real tracking.
- Tools (v0.3).

=== Dependencies ===
- None. Foundational for v0.2.

=== Testing ===
- Unit tests with injected git/adapter/clock stubs (same pattern as v0.1's prompt::tests).
- Integration test: lernie new → lernie prompt against mock → assert the new branch exists, goal.md is on it, step commit is on the branch, main's HEAD is unchanged.
- cargo test + tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green.
title: Exchange branch + step on branch
